d:
Welcome to another episode of my 6,000 KM USA Road Trip!
In this episode, we finally make our way to one of America’s most famous national parks, Yellowstone National Park, known for its incredible landscapes, wildlife, mountains, and geothermal wonders.
But our adventure took an unexpected turn!
We were planning to explore Yellowstone and spend the night camping in our friend’s black Mercedes Sprinter campervan. However, the weather had completely different plans for us.
